title: NASA moon program development at Langley

tellings.quote: NASA's development to get up into space and everything pressurization was done at Langley Air Force Base, Virginia.

plain: Dylan Borland, a former Air Force member who talks about UFO secrets, says that in the 1960s much of the work NASA, the US space agency, did to reach space, including the work on pressurization, keeping air pressure safe for astronauts, took place at Langley Air Force Base in Virginia. He tells it as background about the base and what went on there, as part of a larger story he tells on Jesse Michels's podcast.
